proposedRoleDescriptions.color: A warm/glowing media ground and chart accents are separate from basic text/action surfaces. The screenshot's shadows need measurement before creating global elevation tokens.
proposedRoleDescriptions.typography: Pair an editorial serif display with practical sans labels and metrics. Preserve numeric readability and meaning.

limits.semanticRoles: Null roles are deliberate. Element measurements do not establish canonical site-wide roles or scales.
limits.visibility: Nonzero element geometry does not prove visibility through loaders or overlays. Computed family requests do not prove successful font loading.
limits.coverage: Selected desktop samples and a supplied reference image when available; no complete responsive, interaction or accessibility audit.
limits.sourceDifferences: The image visibly contains glow and shadows despite prose emphasizing near-flat surfaces. Exact effects require source inspection.
limits.ownership: Third-party reference, not an approved production pack.
